author: Zintenka
body:
The Points Shop enhanced gameplay greatly and was a very cool niche of Avicus.

I'd suggest to allow people to customize the points shop to fit the theme to the map, would be a great addition and here's how I believe it could work to severely enhance Atlas gameplay and make everyone want to make maps for Atlas.

Map makers can either leave the Credits Shop as it's default setting OR can customize the Credit Shop's items through XML and get credits from every item that is bought in the Credits Shop.

Or you can just... deny there being a Credits Shop.

- If you do not customize the Credits Shop then you will not get any Credits bought on your map

- If you do customize the Credits Shop, then you get credits from each item purchased.

- If you customize it to be 80-90% identical as the regular shop or remove some items and keep the default, then you won't get anything at all.

- You can deny there being a Credits Shop on a map if you wish

replies.body: It would be neat to have again but it violates the EULA because donors get a credit boost allowing them easier access to items that affect gameplay.
